boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named food destinations along the Brown Street corridor beside the University of Dayton, each with a directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: FUSIAN Dayton
cards.subtitle: Brown Street corridor beside University of Dayton
cards.notes: Use the Brown Street location when you want to order from its sushi menu; the business lists this Dayton address and daily hours.
cards.short_summary: A sushi stop at 1200 Brown St.
cards.evidence_claim: FUSIAN lists its Dayton restaurant at 1200 Brown St., Dayton, with daily hours of 10:40 a.m.–10:05 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; check the official page for current ordering and hours.

cards.title: BIBIBOP University of Dayton
cards.subtitle: Brown Street corridor beside University of Dayton
cards.notes: Build a bowl at the University of Dayton location; its official listing identifies the Brown Street address and online ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: BIBIBOP lists its University of Dayton location at 1200 Brown St., Unit 140, and describes it as on Brown Street near the university.
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; current store hours are posted on the official location page.

cards.title: Ben & Jerry's Dayton Scoop Shop
cards.subtitle: Brown Street corridor beside University of Dayton
cards.notes: Visit the Brown Street scoop shop for its posted ice-cream menu or takeout options; confirm flavors before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: An ice-cream shop at 1934 Brown St.
cards.evidence_claim: Ben & Jerry's lists its Dayton Scoop Shop at 1934 Brown Street, Dayton, and provides its menu and takeout information.
cards.source_title: Dayton, OH Ice Cream Shop - Ben & Jerry’s
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; official page posts daily hours.

cards.title: Five Guys University Shoppes
cards.subtitle: Brown Street corridor beside University of Dayton
cards.notes: Choose this listed University Shoppes location for dine-in, takeout, or delivery; use the official page to check availability.
cards.short_summary: A Five Guys location with several service options.
cards.evidence_claim: Five Guys identifies University Shoppes at 1143 Brown Street, Dayton, and lists dine-in, takeout, and delivery services.
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; service availability and hours are posted by the business.

cards.title: Jimmy John's 0557
cards.subtitle: Brown Street corridor beside University of Dayton
cards.notes: Use the shop's official ordering page to arrange pickup or delivery from its Brown Street address and verify hours for your visit.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich shop at 1157 Brown St.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John's lists store 0557 at 1157 Brown St., Dayton, with pickup, delivery, and indoor seating.
cards.source_title: Sandwich Shop & Gourmet Subs in Dayton | Jimmy John's 0557
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; official page lists current service and store hours.

cards.title: Skyline Chili University of Dayton
cards.subtitle: Brown Street corridor beside University of Dayton
cards.notes: Stop at the University of Dayton Skyline location for its menu and ordering options; check the location page for the day's schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Skyline Chili location on Brown Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Skyline Chili lists its University of Dayton location at 1153 Brown Street, Dayton, with online ordering and posted store hours.
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; the official location page posts current hours.

cards.title: Butter Café
cards.subtitle: Brown Street corridor beside University of Dayton
cards.notes: Plan a breakfast, brunch, or lunch visit at this Brown Street café; its official site also notes vegan and gluten-free options.
cards.short_summary: A daytime café with breakfast through lunch.
cards.evidence_claim: Butter Café lists 1106 Brown St. and says it serves breakfast, brunch, and lunch seven days a week, including vegan and gluten-free options.
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; official hours are Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–2 p.m. and weekends 8 a.m.–3 p.m.

cards.title: Hickory Bar-B-Q
cards.subtitle: Brown Street corridor beside University of Dayton
cards.notes: Check the restaurant's posted schedule before heading to its Brown Street address, then order from its barbecue-focused restaurant menu.
cards.short_summary: A family-owned barbecue restaurant at 1082 Brown St.
cards.evidence_claim: Hickory Bar-B-Q lists 1082 Brown St., Dayton, and states that the Kiss family has owned the restaurant since 1962.
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; the business posts hours and notes Monday and Tuesday closures.

cards.title: Playa Bowls Dayton
cards.subtitle: Brown Street corridor beside University of Dayton
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm the daily schedule, then visit the 1200 Brown Street shop for bowls and related menu items.
cards.short_summary: A bowls shop in the University Place cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: Playa Bowls lists its Dayton location at 1200 Brown Street, Space 105, and states that it is open every day from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; official page lists daily 8 a.m.–8 p.m. hours.

cards.title: Brown Street Bistro
cards.subtitle: Brown Street corridor beside University of Dayton
cards.notes: Head to the fifth floor of Fitz Hall for this student-operated café, then check Flyer Enterprises for its currently posted service details.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent café named for the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Flyer Enterprises states that Brown Street Bistro is located on the fifth floor of Fitz Hall.
cards.source_title: Brown St. Bistro | Flyer Enterprises | University of Dayton
cards.access_notes: Purchase required; located on the University of Dayton campus beside the Brown Street corridor.
